DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 紙幣の角が破れています。小さい破片もありますが、先にテープで貼れば使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 角が破れた紙幣と破片のテープ補修について相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The corner of this banknote is torn. I have the small piece too. Can I use it if I tape it together first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about repairing a banknote's torn corner with tape when you also have the fragment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身で補修する前に、紙幣と破片を担当へ見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Before repairing it yourself, please show the banknote and fragment to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ貼っていません。財布に残っていた破片を別の袋へ入れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未補修で財布に残る破片を別袋へ保持済みと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not taped it yet. I put the fragment that was left in my wallet into a separate bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not repaired it and have kept the fragment left in your wallet in a separate bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 紛失しないようそのままお持ちください。同じ紙幣の破片かも確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please keep it as it is so you do not lose it. We also need to check whether the fragment belongs to the same banknote.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ物だと思いますが、自分では合う位置を確かめていません。担当に見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同一紙幣と思うが接合未確認なので担当確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I think it is from the same note, but I have not checked where it fits myself. I would like the person in charge to look at it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you think it belongs to the same note but have not checked whether the pieces fit, and ask the staff member in charge to check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取扱いと確認の方法をご案内します。すぐ交換できる額はここで決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will explain how it is handled and checked. We cannot determine here the amount that can be exchanged immediately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 額を自分で決めて用紙に書かず、まず状態の確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自己判断で交換額を書かず紙幣状態確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Rather than decide the amount myself and write it on the form, I would first like you to check its condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the banknote's condition to be checked without deciding and writing an exchange amount yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。ほかの紙幣と混ぜず、対象だけをお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please hand over only the banknote concerned without mixing it with other notes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 破れた一枚と袋の破片を分けたまま渡し、確認の結果と手続きを聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象一枚と別袋破片を渡し確認結果と手続きを聞くと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will hand over the one torn banknote and the fragment in its separate bag, keeping them apart, and ask about the check result and procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will hand over the single banknote and separately bagged fragment and ask about the result and procedure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。担当窓口へおつなぎします。破片も残してお持ちくださりありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. I will connect you with the counter in charge. Thank you for bringing the fragment as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 上の棚の飲料箱を一箱買いたいです。重いので、取ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 上棚の重い飲料箱一箱を取ってほしいと店員へ依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to buy one case of drinks from the top shelf. It is heavy. Could you get it down for me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask a staff member to get one heavy case of drinks down from an upper shelf. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。どの商品でしょうか。棚へ登らずにお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Certainly. Which product is it? Please wait without climbing on the shelves.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 右側の水の箱です。下の箱へ足をかけようとしましたが、まだ乗っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 右側の水を指定し下箱へ足をかけようとしたがまだ乗っていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The case of water on the right. I was about to step on a box below, but I have not climbed onto it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify the water on the right and explain that you were about to step on a lower box but have not done so yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品を踏台にしないでください。こちらで一箱お取りします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do not use products as a step. I will get one case for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。取った後も自分で持ち歩かず、買物カートに入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 箱取得後は持ち抱えずカートで運びたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. After it is down, I would like to put it in a shopping cart instead of carrying it in my arms.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that after the case is retrieved, you want to move it by cart rather than carry it in your arms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ではカートをこちらへ寄せてください。通路を空けて載せましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please bring the cart over here. Let us keep the aisle clear as we load it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: カートはこの位置でよいですか。ほかの食品をつぶさないよう箱を先に載せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: カート位置を確認し軽い食品を潰さぬよう箱を先に載せたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Is this a good place for the cart? I would like to load the case first so it does not crush the other food.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the cart's position and ask to load the case first so lighter food will not be crushed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。軽い物は別の置き方を考えましょう。無理に手で抱えなくて構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Let us think about where to place the lighter items separately. You do not have to force yourself to carry it by hand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 水一箱をカートで運び、棚へ登らず店員さんに頼むようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 水一箱をカートで運び棚へ登らず店員へ依頼すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will carry one case of water in the cart and ask a staff member rather than climb the shelves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will transport one case of water by cart and ask staff rather than climb the shelves. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。どうぞお買物を続けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please continue your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもが落葉の山で遊びたがっています。この山は入ってもよい物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子供が希望する落葉の山が遊ぶ対象か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child wants to play in the pile of fallen leaves. Is this a pile they are allowed to go into?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the pile of fallen leaves your child wants to enter is intended for play. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは清掃で集めた物です。中に枝などが混じるので、遊ぶための山ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: These leaves were gathered during cleaning. There may be branches mixed in, so this is not a pile for playing in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 遊び用と思っていました。まだ入っていないので子どもを離れさせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 遊び用と思ったが未進入なので子供を離すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was for play. My child has not gone in yet, so I will move them away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you thought it was for play, but your child has not entered and you will move them away. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。清掃用具や作業区域にも近づかないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. Please also stay away from the cleaning equipment and work areas.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 作業が終わるまで待つより、別の遊び場へ行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 清掃完了待ちでなく別の遊び場へ行きたいと希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to go to another play area instead of waiting for the work to finish.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to go to another play area rather than wait for cleaning to finish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ここでは、一般の遊び場は反対側の表示に沿って行けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here, you can reach the regular play area by following the signs on the opposite side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 作業する人の後ろを通らず、表示された通路を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 作業員後方を通らず指定通路を使うと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will use the marked path rather than walk behind the people working.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will use the designated path rather than pass behind the workers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。お子様と一緒に、作業区域を避けて移動してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please move together with your child while avoiding the work area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 落葉の山へ入らず子どもと通路へ戻り、一般の遊び場へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 落葉に入らず子供と通路経由で一般遊戯場へ行くと復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will stay out of the leaf pile, return to the path together, and head to the regular play area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will not enter the leaf pile and will go with your child along the path to the regular play area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。どうぞ気をつけてお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please take care and enjoy yourselves.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この旅行鞄が勝手に転がりました。車輪が止まらないので、列車を待つ場所を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車輪が止まらない旅行鞄が転がったため待機位置を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: This suitcase rolled away on its own. The wheels will not stay still, so I would like to ask where I should wait for the train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a waiting position after a suitcase with wheels that will not stay still rolled away. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず鞄から手を離さずお持ちください。今はご自身で止めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, please keep hold of the suitcase without letting go. Are you keeping it still yourself now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、取っ手を持っています。電話の表示を見ていた間に少し動き、すぐつかみました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在保持済みで電話を見た間に動き直ちにつかんだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I am holding the handle. It moved a little while I was looking at my phone, and I caught it immediately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are holding it now and that it moved while you were looking at your phone, but you caught it at once. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ホームの端へ近づかず、案内された線の内側で周囲の通行を妨げない位置に移りましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us move away from the platform edge to a position inside the marked line where you will not obstruct others passing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 鞄も一緒に動かします。壁へ押しつければ止まると決めず、取っ手を持ったまま待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鞄と移動し壁固定をあてにせず保持継続すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will move with the suitcase. I will not assume that pushing it against a wall will keep it still; I will wait while holding the handle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will move with the suitcase and keep holding it rather than rely on a wall to stop it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それでお願いします。電話を見るときも鞄を放さないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do that. Do not let go of the suitcase when you look at your phone either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 片手で持ち、もう片方で時刻だけ確認します。長い操作は乗る前にやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 片手保持で時刻のみ確認し長操作はやめると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will hold it with one hand and use the other only to check the time. I will stop any lengthy phone use before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will hold it with one hand, check only the time, and stop lengthy phone operations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 列車が来たら、乗り降りする方を待ってから鞄と一緒に進んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: When the train comes, please wait for people boarding and alighting, then proceed with your suitcase.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 動かないよう保持して待ち、乗るときも鞄を先に押し出さず自分で運びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 待機と乗車時とも本人が鞄を保持して運ぶと復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep it from moving while I wait, and when boarding I will carry it with me rather than push it ahead of myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will keep hold of and move your suitcase yourself both while waiting and when boarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。車輪にも気をつけてご乗車ください。よいご旅行を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please watch the wheels when boarding too. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 近所に掲示板を置く方法を知りたいです。地域の代表として来たわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 掲示板設置方法を地域代表でなく個人として問い合わせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to know how to install a neighborhood noticeboard. I have not come as a representative of the community.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Inquire as an individual, rather than as a community representative, about how to install a noticeboard. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人の問い合わせとして伺います。近所の方とは相談されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will take this as your personal inquiry. Have you discussed it with your neighbors?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二人とは話しましたが、全員が賛成したわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 近隣二人と話したが地域全員賛成ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have spoken with two people, but that does not mean everyone has agreed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have spoken with two neighbors but do not have the agreement of the whole community. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、地域全体の決定とはせず、方法を調べる段階ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then you are at the stage of researching the method, rather than reporting a decision by the whole community.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。必要な相談先や、検討するときの項目を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 意思決定前の調査として相談先と検討項目を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Please tell me whom I need to consult and what matters should be considered.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whom to consult and what matters to consider while researching before a decision. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へつなぎます。場所の所有や管理についても確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will connect you with the person in charge. Ownership and management of the location also need to be checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 候補はありますが、勝手に設置するのでなく管理者を先に調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 候補地があるが無断設置せず管理者を調べると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a possible location, but I will first find out who manages it rather than install it without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have a candidate site but will find out its manager instead of installing the board without permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その段階を説明できます。担当から必要な確認事項を聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can explain that stage of the process. Please ask the person in charge what needs to be confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 個人の問い合わせとして相談し、場所の管理者と地域の意向を別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 個人相談で場所管理と地域意向を別々に確かめると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will make this a personal inquiry, and check the site's management and the community's wishes separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that this is an individual inquiry and that you will check management of the site separately from the community's wishes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当窓口はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The counter in charge is here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 医師に薬のことを質問したいですが、名前を覚えていません。薬の袋は持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 薬名不明だが薬袋持参で医師へ質問したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to ask the doctor about a medicine, but I do not remember its name. I have brought the medicine bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you do not know the medicine's name but have brought its bag and want to ask the doctor about it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋を診療担当へ見せると相談できます。どんなことを聞きたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can discuss it by showing the bag to the clinical staff. What would you like to ask?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前回の説明で、いつ質問すればよいか迷いました。今日は使い方をもう一度聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前回の使い方説明を今回もう一度聞きたいと具体的に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: During the previous explanation, I was unsure when to ask questions. Today, I would like to hear how to use it again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specifically say that you would like to hear the previous instructions for use again at this visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使い方は診療担当へ確認しましょう。受付で似た名前の薬を選ぶことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the usage with the clinical staff. Reception will not choose a medicine with a similar name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前を推測せず、この袋にある物について質問すると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 似た薬名を推測せず袋の対象について質問すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not guess the name, and will say that I have a question about what is in this bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask about the medicine in the bag without guessing a similar-sounding medicine name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。袋と質問のメモを分けて用意できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. You can prepare the bag and a note of your questions separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: メモには、前回わからなかった点と、聞き直したいことだけ書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未理解点と再質問内容のみメモすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: On the note, I will write only what I did not understand last time and what I would like to ask again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will note only the points you did not understand and the questions you want to ask again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ実物の表示とメモを一緒に見せてください。ここでは使い方を変えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show the actual label and your note together to the person in charge. Please do not change how you use it here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 薬袋を示して医師へ聞き直し、説明を確認するまで自己判断で変更しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 薬袋とメモで医師へ確認し自己判断で使用変更しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the medicine bag and ask the doctor again. I will not change anything on my own until I have confirmed the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check with the doctor using the medicine bag and note, and not change usage on your own. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。そのご相談を担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will pass that inquiry to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 個人との取引で代金を送りましたが、連絡がなくなりました。商品はまだ届いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 個人間取引で送金後連絡が途絶え商品未着と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I sent payment for a transaction with an individual, but they have stopped responding. The item has not arrived yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about an individual-to-individual transaction where contact stopped after payment and the item has not arrived. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 送金した日時と、相手とのやり取りの記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the payment date and time and a record of your exchanges with the other party?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方に送りました。支払記録と、商品の説明を残しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日夕方の送金記録と商品説明が保存済みと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I sent it yesterday evening. I have kept the payment record and the item description.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have saved the record of yesterday evening's payment and the item description. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品の発送について、相手から何か案内はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Did the other party tell you anything about shipping the item?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 発送予定とは言われましたが、送ったという連絡や番号はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発送予定発言のみで発送完了連絡と番号はないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: They said they planned to ship it, but there has been no message saying it was sent and no tracking number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that there was only a statement of planned shipping, without confirmation of shipment or a number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 未受領と、発送したか未確認という状態を分けて伺います。追加の支払いを求められていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will distinguish between not having received it and not knowing whether it was shipped. Have you been asked to make any additional payment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は求められていません。自分からもう一度払って確かめようとはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加請求はなく自発的再送金もしないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not at the moment. I have not tried to check by making another payment on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that no additional payment has been requested and that you will not voluntarily send payment again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録を消さず、相談担当へ見せてください。取引の経緯を順に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep the records rather than delete them, and show them to the adviser. They will check the course of the transaction in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昨日の送金は済み、受取はなく発送は不明だと、記録と一緒に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 送金済みと未受領と発送不明を区別して記録を提示すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain with the records that I paid yesterday, have not received the item, and do not know whether it was shipped.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish completed payment, nonreceipt, and unknown shipment status when presenting the records. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当が詳しくお話を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The person in charge will hear the details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二通の封筒がくっついてしまいました。のりが乾く前に重ねたようです。まだ差し出していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: のり未乾燥で二封筒が貼り付き未発送だと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two envelopes have stuck together. I seem to have stacked them before the glue dried. I have not posted them yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that two envelopes stuck together because the glue was still wet and that they have not been mailed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 無理に引っ張らず状態を確認しましょう。すでにはがそうとしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check their condition without pulling them apart forcibly. Have you already tried to separate them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 少し引いたら片方の端が破れました。中の手紙はまだ取り出していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: はがしかけ一方が破れ中身は未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: When I pulled a little, the edge of one tore. I have not taken the letter inside out yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that one envelope tore when you began separating them and that its contents have not been checked yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 破れた封筒をそのまま送る前に、手紙の状態と新しい封筒を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Before sending the torn envelope as it is, please check the letter's condition and prepare a new envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新しい封筒を持っています。破れた方の手紙だけ移し、宛先を書き直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持参の新封筒へ破損側の手紙だけ移したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a new envelope. I would like to move only the letter from the torn one and rewrite the addressee.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to move only the letter from the damaged envelope into the new envelope you brought. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二通の中身と宛先を一通ずつ照合してください。どちらも同じ相手ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please match each letter's contents with its addressee one by one. Are they both for the same person?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 違います。破れた方は姉宛てで、無傷の方は会社宛てです。移すのは姉の手紙だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 破損側は姉で無傷側は会社宛てと区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. The torn one is for my older sister, and the undamaged one is for a company. I am only moving my sister's letter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the damaged envelope for your older sister from the undamaged one for the company. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では姉様宛てを整え、二通を別々に重さと大きさで確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then let us put the one for your sister in order and check the two envelopes' weights and sizes separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手紙が傷んでいないか見て姉宛てを入れ直し、のりが乾くまで重ねずに待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手紙状態確認と再封を行い乾くまで重ねないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check that the letter is not damaged, put my sister's letter in the new envelope, and wait without stacking them until the glue dries.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the letter's condition, reseal it, and not stack the envelopes until they are dry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。準備ができてから二通をお持ちください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please bring both envelopes once they are ready. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 振込後の控えを見ています。相手へ送った額は、この合計の数字でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 送金後控えの合計数字が相手へ送った額か質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am looking at the receipt after making a transfer. Is this total the amount I sent to the other person?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the total on a transfer receipt is the amount sent to the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この控えの合計には手数料が含まれています。振込額の欄を別に見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The total on this receipt includes the fee. Let us look at the transfer amount field separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 手数料まで相手へ送ったと思っていました。振込額と手数料は別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手数料も受取人へ送ったと思った誤解を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought the fee had been sent to the recipient too. The transfer amount and the fee are separate, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct your misunderstanding that the fee was also sent to the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。口座から出た合計と、振込を依頼した額は区別できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. You can distinguish the total withdrawn from your account from the amount you requested to transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 相手へ連絡するメモには振込額だけ書きます。届いたかは相手に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相手向けメモへ振込額のみ書き着金は相手確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will write only the transfer amount in the note for the recipient. I will ask them whether it has arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will note only the transfer amount for the recipient and check receipt with them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そうしてください。控えだけで相手の口座への反映まで断定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do. The receipt alone does not establish that it has been reflected in the recipient's account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 手数料は自分の記録として別に控え、相手へ追加送金したとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手数料を本人記録へ分け追加送金とは説明しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will note the fee separately for my own records and will not say it was an additional transfer to the recipient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will record the fee separately for yourself and not describe it as an additional transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。必要な欄だけ確認し、控えを保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please check only the fields you need and keep the receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 振込額と手数料を分けて記録し、届いたかは確認してから報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 依頼額と手数料を分け着金確認後に結果報告すると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will record the transfer amount and fee separately and report the result after checking whether the money arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will separate the requested transfer amount from the fee and report the result after confirming receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。ご不明な点があればまたお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Please ask us again if there is anything you are unsure of.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人の商品も同じかごにあります。支払いは別なので、登録前に分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人と同かごだが別支払なので商品登録前に分けたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend's items are in the same basket. We are paying separately, so I would like to separate them before they are entered.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to separate items before checkout entry because you and your friend share a basket but will pay separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ登録していません。どちらがお客様の分でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I have not entered them yet. Which items are yours?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 牛乳と米は私です。パンと果物は友人が自分で払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人牛乳米と友人パン果物を具体的に区分する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The milk and rice are mine. My friend will pay for the bread and fruit themselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify that the milk and rice are yours, while the bread and fruit belong to your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、こちらの仕切りを使って会計を二つに分けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us use this divider to make two separate transactions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。全部を私の会計にした後で金額を割る依頼ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 全体会計後の割勘依頼ではないと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I am not asking to put everything on my bill and split the amount afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Make clear that you are not requesting to divide the cost after a single combined checkout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれの品を、支払う方が確認してから登録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will enter each person's items after the person paying checks them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人にも自分の品を見てもらいます。私の米を友人の側へ置かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人にも自分の商品を照合してもらい米は本人側へ置くと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will have my friend check their own items too. I will make sure not to put my rice on my friend's side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will have your friend check their own items and keep the rice on your own side. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できましたら、お一人ずつ会計します。袋も別に用意されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once everything is confirmed, I will check you out one at a time. Will you have separate bags as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それぞれの袋があります。品と支払いを分けて、私から会計してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 各自袋を使い商品支払を分け本人分から会計してほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: We each have our own bag. Please separate the items and payments and check out mine first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will use your own bags, separate the items and payments, and ask to pay for your own items first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お客様の品だけ先にお会計します。ご利用ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04216-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will check out only your items first. Thank you for shopping with us.
